prompt.title: Complete your learning diagnosis first
prompt.description: Answer a few questions so your first activity matches your goals and available time.

learningGoal.label: What is your main goal right now?
learningGoal.description: Choose the outcome that matters most for your next learning cycle.

level.label: How do you describe your current level?
level.description: Use your own judgment. This answer is a starting point, not a grade.

technologies.label: Which technologies interest you?
technologies.description: Choose up to five technologies you would like to practice.

availability.label: How much time can you dedicate each week?
availability.description: A rough range helps us avoid recommending more work than fits your routine.

experience.label: What relevant experience do you already have?
experience.description: Tell us about projects, work, studies, or anything else that helps us understand your starting point.
experience.placeholder: For example: I have built small React projects and completed a programming course.
